resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale Certificate of Occupancy. The Township's Zoning page says a certificate of occupancy is not required for a home sale; only the state Smoke Detector Fire Safety Certification is needed (see fire certificate).

evidence.quote: If you are selling your home, a Smoke Detector Fire Safety Certification from the State is required.
A certificate of occupancy is not required for a home sale.

resale_co.notes: The Township Zoning page states in writing that no certificate of occupancy is needed for a home sale. Union Township transferred enforcement of the Uniform Construction Code to the NJ Department of Community Affairs (Code Chapter 10), so building and construction inspections are handled by DCA (908-713-0722 per the Township's Departments page). Landlord registration (Township Clerk) applies only to rentals.

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level, including basements (not crawl spaces or unfinished attics), and outside each separate sleeping area
Carbon monoxide alarm outside each separate sleeping area, within 10 feet of bedrooms
All alarms in working order; AC powered or interconnected alarms in homes built after January 1977 must be kept working
Portable fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)

fire_cert.notes: Union Township (Hunterdon) is state-enforced for the fire code (LEA registry code S; the state directory lists it as Enf Auth. State, LEAID 1025-999). The Township's Zoning and Fire pages link to the state's online application at firesolutions.dca.nj.gov, and its Departments page lists NJ DCA at 908-713-0722 for smoke detectors. Note the registry also lists a different Union Township (Union County, code F); the S entry is the Hunterdon one. The only published state fee schedule found is on DCA form SD-41 (revised 10/02, an application and certification in lieu of inspection), which also still lists a portable fire extinguisher; the state dropped the extinguisher from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19). The current online portal does not show fees publicly. Confirm the current state fee and process with the Division of Fire Safety at (609) 633-6132. Update: the current state fees are $45 / $90 / $161, set by N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d) (50 N.J.R. 729(a)) (more than 10, 4 to 10, and under 4 business days before closing). The $35 / $70 / $125 on the older DCA paper form are out of date.
